task:
A levy charges 18% on the first 3000 credits of a 2980-credit bill and 32% on the remainder. Subtract a 3-credit rebate from the levy (floor at zero), then apply a 7% surcharge to that reduced levy. What is the exact final levy? No rounding. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 15 credits, then discount the whole amount by 5%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 16% surcharge, then subtract 22 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 17 credits, then discount the whole amount by 15%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 7% surcharge, then subtract 22 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 20 credits, then discount the whole amount by 19%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 19% surcharge, then subtract 3 credits.
Adjustment 7: add 15 credits, then discount the whole amount by 10%.
Adjustment 8: apply a 5% surcharge, then subtract 11 credits.
Adjustment 9: add 17 credits, then discount the whole amount by 14%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 14% surcharge, then subtract 23 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 13 credits, then discount the whole amount by 8%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 4% surcharge, then subtract 13 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 3 credits, then discount the whole amount by 15%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 9% surcharge, then subtract 5 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 3 credits, then discount the whole amount by 6%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
